name: NewBar
summary: NewBar is a utility class that detects the formation of new bars on a specified chart timeframe. It provides a simple boolean method to check if the current tick belongs to a new bar, preventing multiple signal processing within the same bar. This is a foundational building block commonly used by other trading EAs to ensure one trade per bar.
summary_zh: NewBar是一个工具类，用于检测指定图表时间周期上新K线的形成。它提供一个简单的布尔方法来检查当前tick是否属于新K线，防止在同一根K线内多次处理信号。这是其他交易EA常用的基础构建模块，用于确保每根K线只交易一次。
strategy_analysis: NewBar本身不是一个交易策略，而是一个技术工具类，用于检测新K线的形成。其核心概念是通过比较当前K线的时间戳与上一次记录的K线时间戳，判断是否进入了新的K线周期。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，因为该类仅提供时间检测功能。该工具通常被其他EA调用，以避免在同一根K线上重复开仓或重复计算信号，是构建稳健交易系统的重要基础设施组件。
strategy_analysis_en: NewBar is not a trading strategy itself but a technical utility class designed to detect the formation of new bars on a chart. Its core concept compares the current bar's timestamp against a previously stored timestamp to determine whether a new bar has started. Entry conditions are not applicable since this tool does not execute any trading operations. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing and money management are not involved as the class solely provides time-detection functionality. This tool is typically called by other EAs to prevent duplicate order placement or redundant signal calculation within the same bar, making it an essential infrastructure component for building robust trading systems.

parameters.name: LastBarTime
parameters.description: 上一根K线的时间戳记录

pros: 简洁高效的新K线检测机制，减少重复信号处理
模块化设计，可被其他EA轻松集成复用
避免了同一K线内多次开仓的常见问题，提升系统稳定性
pros_en: Simple and efficient new bar detection mechanism that reduces duplicate signal processing
Modular design allowing easy integration and reuse by other EAs
Prevents the common problem of multiple entries within the same bar, improving system stability
cons: 仅提供单一功能，不包含任何交易逻辑
缺少对多时间周期同时检测的支持
没有错误处理机制应对时间戳异常或数据刷新情况
cons_en: Provides only a single function with no trading logic included
Lacks support for simultaneous multi-timeframe bar detection
No error handling mechanism for timestamp anomalies or data refresh scenarios
improvements: 增加多时间周期新K线检测支持，允许同时监控多个周期
添加IsNewBar回调事件或信号机制，使调用方更灵活
加入数据刷新和异常时间戳的处理逻辑
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe new bar detection support to monitor multiple periods simultaneously
Implement IsNewBar callback event or signal mechanism for more flexible caller integration
Add handling logic for data refresh and anomalous timestamp situations

risk_points: 该工具为纯工具类，不涉及任何交易风险
需确保调用方正确使用新K线标志，否则可能导致逻辑错误
risk_points_en: This tool is a pure utility class with no trading risk involved
Must ensure callers correctly use the new bar flag, otherwise logic errors may occur
